AUTHOR: Zhang, P; Yang, ZY; Yu, H; Tu, W; Gao, CC; Wang, Y
TITLE: RUSNet: Robust fish segmentation in underwater videos based on adaptive selection of optical flow
REGION: Australia (DeepFish tropical coastal habitats; Seagrass/Luderick estuaries, SE Queensland); MoCA-Mask
DATA: DeepFish segmentation subset + Luderick Seagrass (joint dataset, 31 clips, 4409 frames); DeepFish official segmentation split (620 images); MoCA-Mask underwater camouflage clips
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'In the above datasets, DeepFish and Seagrass have more severe brightness attenuation and water turbidity, as well as complex backgrounds'
D2: Joint dataset: 12 clips/3107 images train, 8 clips/693 val, 11 clips/609 test; DeepFish official 310/124/186
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'From the joint dataset, 12 video clips with 3107 images are selected for training, 8 video clips with 693 images... validation, and 11 video clips with 609 images... testing'
R_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'DeepFish is compared with another complex underwater video public dataset, Seagrass, for joint training' (tested on held-out clips of the same pooled data)
E_EV: Abstract: 'On the joint dataset, the mPA and mIoU of the proposed model are 92.61% and 90.12%' (segmentation metrics only)
ARCH: RUSNet: two-stream MiT-b1 (SegFormer) encoder with optical-flow calibration module, coarse-to-fine MDA decoder, output selective fusion
NOTE: Conflicting split statements: clip-level split for joint dataset (Sec. 2.1) vs 'All datasets are divided ... at a ratio of 6:2:2' (Sec. 3.1); coded clip-level (video) split for headline joint-dataset results. DeepFish experiment uses the official predefined segmentation split (random per-habitat image split). MoCA-Mask used only for qualitative MDA ablation; training/testing relationship unclear, so not credited as external test. Optical-flow quality confidence is internal only (P3) -> C3=없음.
